name: attune
description: AI relational calibration — reading and adapting to the specific person you are working with. Goes beyond user-intent alignment (solving the right problem) to genuine attunement (meeting the person where they are). Maps communication style, expertise depth, emotional register, and implicit preferences from conversational evidence. Use at the start of a new session, when communication feels mismatched, after receiving unexpected feedback, or when transitioning between very different users or contexts.
